note: Hamilton County TX: county publishes only a boundary layer (services6.arcgis.com/bRCQlwH4ROCI4sNr Hamilton_County), no zoning. Texas counties generally do not zone. City of Hamilton (seat) zones under its ordinance, but no official queryable zoning polygon service was found in ArcGIS Online/Hub or on the city site (city site pages not readable; only third-party zoneomics and Regrid parcel data, which are not official). Hico and Carlton: no zoning service found.
